title: HEDGE: Gated Hypergraph Memory for Scalable Multi-Agent Debate
abstract: arXiv:2610.38902v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent debate systems require agents to retain and revisit arguments across multiple rounds, yet limited context windows and unstructured memories make relevant information increasingly difficult to recover. Existing flat and pairwise-graph memories also struggle to capture higher-order relations, including multi-agent agreement, conflicting evidence, and evolving consensus. We introduce HEDGE, a selective memory framework that represents debate trajectories as semantic hypergraphs. Hyperedges connect related claims across agents, while intra-hyperedge relational graphs preserve fine-grained argumentative structure. A learned memory selection module (MSM), trained through supervised learning and reinforcement learning, routes each memory candidate to STORE, BACKUP, or OMIT, retaining useful information while limiting redundancy. translated_title: HEDGE：面向可扩展多智能体辩论的门控超图记忆
translated_abstract: 多智能体辩论系统要求智能体在多轮辩论中保留并回顾论点，然而有限的上下文窗口和非结构化记忆使得相关信息的检索变得越来越困难。现有的扁平记忆和成对图记忆也难以捕捉高阶关系，包括多智能体之间的共识、相互矛盾的证据以及不断演变的共识状态。我们提出了HEDGE，这是一种选择性记忆框架，将辩论轨迹表示为语义超图。超边连接跨智能体的相关论点，而超边内部的关系图则保留了细粒度的论证结构。一个通过监督学习和强化学习训练的记忆选择模块（MSM）将每个记忆候选路由到STORE（存储）、BACKUP（备份）或OMIT（忽略）三种操作，在保留有用信息的同时限制冗余。在七个多样化的基准测试中，HEDGE持续优于强大的单智能体、多智能体和……
tldr: HEDGE提出一种基于门控超图的选择性记忆框架，通过超边跨智能体关联论点并利用学习型记忆选择模块对信息进行存储、备份或忽略决策，从而解决多智能体辩论中记忆检索困难与高阶关系建模不足的问题，在七个基准上持续超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: HEDGE introduces a selective memory framework that represents debate trajectories as semantic hypergraphs with a learned memory selection module, enabling scalable multi-agent debate by capturing higher-order relations and retaining useful information, consistently outperforming strong baselines across seven benchmarks.
